title: Officium backlog
description: Lets your agent work your Officium board: the backlog skill (how to pick, work and close a card), the autoloop skill (several agents at once), a reminder of the session order at start, the hooks that keep Officium's view of the agent live (heartbeat, session, status line, attention), and a check that keeps a card with temporary code references out of review.

precedenceTemplates.title: Release train
precedenceTemplates.description: The epic that ships next outranks the rest of the backlog and its cards join the active sprint.

placeholders.label: Key or label of the epic that ships next

rules.name: Next release
rules.reason: The release on the train ships on its date: its cards come before everything else.

precedenceTemplates.title: Compliance first
precedenceTemplates.description: Security cards and cards touching personal data come first, then a client's epic.

placeholders.label: Key or label of the client's epic

rules.name: Security
rules.reason: A security card is never waiting behind feature work.

rules.name: Personal data
rules.reason: A card that touches auth, permissions or personal data is reviewed and shipped first.

rules.name: Client commitment
rules.reason: A client's epic has a promise attached: its cards come before the rest.
